standard.coverage: Covered employers under this state's own act, which adopts or matches the federal rate.
standard.note: Iowa's own rate is $7.25 (Iowa Code 91D.1), reached 2008-01-01 -- Iowa hit $7.25 six months BEFORE the federal rate did.

tipped.note: Iowa caps the tip credit at 40% of the minimum wage, giving a $4.35 cash wage -- well above the federal $2.13.

youthAndTraining.label: Initial employment wage
youthAndTraining.eligibility: First 90 CALENDAR days of employment, any age -- Iowa Code 91D.1(1)(d). Note this is not age-limited, unlike the federal under-20 youth wage.

indexation.note: Not indexed; moves only if the legislature (or Congress) moves it.
